title: MEIKO — Profile Story

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hey, everybody, are you having fun?
MEIKO here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The only reason we're standing here today is because of all the support and songs you've given us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just thinking about it really warms my heart.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll keep cherishing and singing each and every song I've been given!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're nearing the end of the show, but don't you let that enthusiasm drop!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, there's a duet later too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Who I'm singing it with?
Just wait and see!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well then, I hope you'll enjoy the show until the very end!

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/scenario/profile/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
